query: INSERT INTO noo_heartbeat_tasks (id, name, schedule, action, config, channels, recipients, enabled, created_by) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, schedule = EXCLUDED.schedule, action = EXCLUDED.action, config = EXCLUDED.config, channels = EXCLUDED.channels, recipients = EXCLUDED.recipients, enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, updated_at = NOW(), next_run = CASE WHEN noo_heartbeat_tasks.schedule IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.schedule THEN NULL ELSE noo_heartbeat_tasks.next_run END
